text:
anne: Quick sync — planning kickoff for EU-Central (eu4) routing + proxy/egress handoff. Need clear owners for: proxy routes, egress ACLs, KMS access for residency exceptions, and canary window. Milestone: staging canary 3/28, GA cutover 4/11. Who owns what?

raj: I can take proxy routes (BGP/api layer + nginx proxy config). Will open an RFC and a small PR for the terraform.

mike: I can own the KMS/decrypt path and key access policy. Raj — once RFC exists I’ll add the kms module changes and the repo policy.

jen: I’ll do the infra PR review and smoke tests. Can we set a 1-hour canary window during EU business hours? Prefer 09:00–10:00 CET.

anne: Yes 09:00–10:00 CET works. Raj — add a section in the RFC for routing fallback policies (region->global fallback, cost tiers).

raj: On it. Quick question: do we allow metrics/logs to egress to US for now? Product asked for short-term exception for observability.

mike: We should avoid logs leaving eu4 by default. For the short-term exception we can create dedicated retention buckets in US with PII filtered. I’ll draft the policy.

jen: Noted. Ops needs a runbook for failover/revoke keys if needed. ops-oncall please weigh in on runbook items.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: For the runbook: steps to revert proxy routes (`terraform apply -var=eu4=false`), revoke KMS key grants, and toggle canary traffic weight to 0 in the load-balancer. Also add alert: `eu4_proxy_5xx_rate > 2% for 5m`.

anne: Nice checklist. Can we embed a minimal route-policy snippet in the RFC? Something like:

```
route_policy {
  match = "path_prefix:/api/v1/"
  primary = "eu4-proxy"
  fallback = ["eu-west-1-proxy", "global-proxy"]
  residency_exceptions = ["metrics-ingest-us (filtered)"]
}
```

raj: Will add that to the RFC. Also tagging owners: `proxy-owner: @raj`, `kms-owner: @mike`, `infra-review: @jen`, `ops-runbook: @ops-oncall`.

mike: FYI I need KMS IAM from cloud-security. @cloud-security can you pre-approve key policy template?

anne: I'll ping cloud-security outside this thread.

jen: PRs: please include smoke test steps and a canary query for latency and token-usage. Example smoke check: `curl -H "x-region-test: eu4" https://eu4.example.com/health` expect 200 and `p95 < 120ms`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment for eu4-staging on 2468313600 (09:00 CET). Will post status updates. :robot_face:

anne: Great — action items: 1) Raj create RFC/PR by EOD tomorrow, 2) Mike draft KMS policy and cloud-security ping, 3) Jen prepare infra review checklist and smoke tests, 4) Ops prepare runbook snippets. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept the owner tag.

raj: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:  

jen: :thumbsup:  

ops-oncall: :thumbsup:

anne: I'll consolidate into the project board and add milestone cards. Thanks all — catching up async works well, will follow up with RFC link here.
